slides.title: Exercise 7 - Diagnostic Exercise
slides.body:
- In
this
exercise
you
have
to
connect
to
the
IPC
and
use
Dianalyzer,
Canalyzer
and
Candela
Studio.
1.
Analyzing
the
database,
extract
the
following
information:
●
List
of
all
RDIs;
●
List
of
all
DTCs
with
attached
DTC
table;
●
List
of
all
I/Os;
●
List
of
all
routines;
2.
What
are
the
main
diagnostic
services?
3.
Faithful
to
the
list
of
RDIs
in
point
1:
●
Request
a
RDI
and
interpret
the
hexadecimal
response;
●
Put
the
IPC
in
the
vehicular
conditions
to
modify
the
content
of
the
selected
RDI;
●
Simulate
a
speed
of
km/h,
request
the
associated
RDI
and
analyze
the
response;
repeat
this
step
simulating
km/h,
km/h
and
km/h.
4.
Write
the
contents
of
RDIs
using
the
speciﬁc
diagnostic
service
and
verify
their
values
by
interrogating
the
control
unit.
5.
Consulting
the
list
of
DTCs:
●
Create
a
fault
condition
●
Evaluate
the
status
byte
●
Carry
out
and
describe
the
operations
needed
to
set:
bit
=
and
bit
=
0.
●
Clear
the
error
memory;
●
Identify
the
snapshot
associated
with
the
error;
●
Request
the
snapshot(s).
